raw.title: Has anyone tried the PersonalLLM dataset for this competition? (namkoong-lab/PersonalLLM)？
Has anyone tried the PersonalLLM dataset for this competition? (namkoong-lab/PersonalLLM)？

firstMessage.content:
Hi all, Has anyone experimented with the PersonalLLM dataset on Hugging Face for this competition?

https://huggingface.co/datasets/namkoong-lab/PersonalLLM

Quick summary: ~10k prompts

Each prompt has 8 responses from different models (GPT-4o, Claude 3 Opus/Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3-70B, Mixtral, etc.)

Model names are clearly labeled

Curious if anyone has already used it for training or style analysis. Does it help much given the model gap with the 18 target models here?

Any major issues with length or domain shift?

Would appreciate any feedback from people who’ve tried it.

Thanks!🤓
